title: LANDWAR-react
subtitle: React-powered website version of the LANDWAR electron app.
features: .CSV download and upload of unit stats.
desc: The electron version of this app turned out to be a bit of a non-starter. Itch.io provided metrics and analytics; the main pdf rules for LANDWAR enjoy continued interest and monthly downloads...the app did not, even offered for free. The solution was then to put the whole thing up on a website. Although the app code was essentially html/js/css, I didn't want to settle for a simple port. I had learned much more about React, ES6, and wanted a new CSS framework.

I decided to give Foundation CSS a try, as an alternative to the normal Bootstrap that most sites use/extend. Post-launch, I am mostly satisfied with Foundation but Material UI is now on my radar. For main framework I chose React, having a desire to learn a lot more about making varied websites and features. It took a bit to get into the headspace of the design, but overall I found making features to be extremely quick and simple to build up.
